change: Reslice with a fixed HU window [-1000, 1000] (clip then fixed-range normalization) instead of the per-patient global min-max.
hypothesis: A fixed physical window gives every patient the same contrast; the esophagus (soft tissue) is no longer crushed against a 3071 HU implant outlier. Expect esophagus Dice to improve; heart and trachea roughly unchanged.

comparison_to_parent.interpretation: Hypothesis confirmed and stronger than expected: a fixed HU window improves all three organs, with the largest gain on trachea. Esophagus improved as predicted (+0.063).

notes: Run locally on MPS; E001 reference was computed on Snellius (CUDA). Same seed/config, but re-running E001 locally would remove any environment difference.
Aorta absent from segthor_part1, reported as n/a.
Training was slower than the earlier local baseline run (~44 vs ~15 min) because the machine was under load; wall-clock not comparable across machines anyway.

what_to_check: Background precision: windowing should not add false positives.
